newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakakibara says relentless yen rise not seen - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Sakakibara says relentless yen rise not seen - Jiji.

text.p: Japan's "Mr Yen", Eisuke Sakakibara, said on Tuesday that the situation was not such that the yen would rise relentlessly, Jiji news agency reported.
Jiji also quoted Sakakibara, the director-general of the Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, as saying he wanted to take steps to keep the sharp yen rise from hurting Japan's economy.
Jiji said Sakakibara made the comments at a meeting of a panel of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party.

The dollar plummeted more than three yen in Tokyo trading time on Tuesday from its close in New York on Monday on expectations of a shrinking interest rate gap between Japan and the United States. It traded at below 112 yen for the first time since December 1996.
